title: Contract and Payment Lapses Found in Auditor-General's Audits of People's Association for FY2020/2021
what_it_is: Contract and Payment Lapses Found in Auditor-General's Audits of People's Association for FY2020/2021

sections.label: Questions on PA payment irregularities
sections.summary: Members asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth about PA payment irregularities, AGO sampling, internal audits and an external consultant's review.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) what lessons are learnt from payment irregularities uncovered by the Auditor General's Office amounting to $1.17 million made by PA to two contractors; and (b) what control measures have been instituted to ensure such irregularities do not recur.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) whether, arising from the sampling of 36 payments conducted by the AGO, PA will conduct a thorough investigation into all payments made in relation to the management of its facility maintenance contracts; (b) what is the total estimate of all such payments; and (c) whether and what steps PA intends to take to recover these irregular payments made.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) whether PA’s internal audits have picked up on any of the lapses that have been raised by AGO; (b) if not, what are the reasons for the failure to do so; and (c) what is the scope and ambit of the external consultant in its review of PA's governance system and oversight functions in relation to contract management of all development projects.

sections.label: AGO findings three issue buckets
sections.summary: Members' questions on AGO findings relate to three buckets: price fluctuation adjustments, contract variation oversight, and OTH operations irregularities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Several Members have raised questions on the AGO findings and they relate to three broad buckets of issues as follows: first, the failure to adopt full price fluctuation adjustments, in the case of OTH's main construction contract; second, management and oversight of contract variations during the construction phase of OTH and HBB; and third, irregularities which arose during the operations and facilities maintenance phase at OTH.

sections.label: OTH 70% price fluctuation adjustment
sections.summary: The parties adopted a 70% price fluctuation adjustment for OTH's main construction contract instead of a full adjustment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Instead of a full price fluctuation adjustment, the parties in that case adopted a 70% price fluctuation adjustment for OTH’s main construction contract.

sections.label: AGO test-checked contract variations
sections.summary: AGO test-checked 465 contract variations from both developments and found lapses in approvals for 252 variations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In its audit, the AGO had test-checked 465 contract variations from both developments and found lapses in the approvals for 252 variations.

sections.label: AGO sampled 36 payments
sections.summary: AGO sampled 36 payments totalling $1.27 million and found possible irregularities in supporting documents, including possible falsification and backdating.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In reviewing the payments made to the contractors, AGO had sampled 36 payments, totalling $1.27 million and found that there were possible irregularities in the supporting documents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: These irregularities include the possible falsification of quotations, alteration of hard copy payments, payment supporting documents and also the creation and backdating of documents to give the false impression that proper processes had been followed.

sections.label: PA lodged Police report
sections.summary: As findings relate to claims involving possible falsification of documents, PA lodged a Police report after the investigation concluded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In addition, as the findings relate to claims involving possible falsification of documents, including in relation to claims by external parties, PA lodged a Police report after the conclusion of this investigation.

sections.label: External consultant audits PA governance
sections.summary: PA appointed an external consultant to audit contract management and review governance of its development projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Besides the above, PA has since appointed an external consultant from a leading accounting firm to examine its governance system and oversight functions in relation to contract management and the operations of all its development projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The external consultant will conduct an audit and Business Process Review on the contract management of development and facility management projects of PA in recent years; review the governance structure for similar integrated community complexes; and also provide recommendations to strengthen systems and also processes in relation to the oversight functions of all development projects.

sections.label: PA commits to improving governance
sections.summary: PA says it is committed to improving governance and oversight and will learn from the AGO audit findings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: PA is committed to resolving and improving its governance and oversight processes and will take all the appropriate steps to learn from and improve on the AGO audit findings.
